items.title: Study - Tomorrow's Primary Forests: The feasibility of realising novel primary forests in the western part of Europe - PE 774.748 - Committee on the Environment, Public Health and Food Safety
items.description: <div>Primary forests are large, self-regulating ecosystems of exceptional ecological importance. In Europe, they are rare, fragmented, and pressured by infrastructure, and intensive forestry. Their strict protection is urgent for biodiversity conservation, climate mitigation, and other ecosystem services. items.title: Green energy isn't Europe's problem — storage is
items.description: Solar and wind produce lots of energy — but not always at the right time. More battery storage could help Europe to stabilize prices and replace polluting fossil fuel energy, but roadblocks remain.
